test.create_query: CREATE TABLE tab ( id UInt64, name String, INDEX idx(name) TYPE text(tokenizer = array) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO tab SELECT number, if(number % 2 = 0, concat('alpha-service-', toString(number % 10), '-prod'), concat('beta-service-', toString(number % 10), '-dev')) FROM numbers(10000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE name LIKE '%service-4-%'
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE name LIKE 'alpha-service-4%'
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE name LIKE '%service-4-prod'
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE name LIKE '%alpha%4%prod%'
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE name LIKE 'alpha-service-4-pro_'
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE name LIKE 'alpha-service-4-prod'
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE name ILIKE '%SERVICE-4-PROD'
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE startsWith(name, 'alpha-service-4')
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE endsWith(name, 'service-4-prod')
